title: VESPER Result
description: A Result reports what a Command actually did. Authority: COC ARCH-04 ('A command is never proof that an action happened'), IC-003, RB-004; REM-010, REM-012.

status.description: 'unknown' is a FIRST-CLASS outcome: the command was issued and the system cannot determine whether the effect occurred. It is never coerced to 'failed' or 'succeeded' -- that coercion is the guess RB-002 forbids. 'proposed' is DF-AUTHORIZE returning PROPOSE. 'halted' is DF-ACTUATION-GATE.

evidence.description: Claim-level evidence for anything this result asserts (REM-010 s4.1). An empty array is valid ONLY when the result asserts nothing.

verification.description: Absent means NOT VERIFIED, which forbids SM-TASK reaching SUCCEEDED (INV-TASK-1).

verified_by.description: INV-VERIF-3: 'self_model' is never silently reported as accepted. 'none_declared' is permitted only for explicitly non-consequential output and is recorded, never silently skipped.

disagreement_ref.description: On failure the disagreement is preserved as evidence. INV-VERIF-1: the task goes to BLOCKED; re-running until the verifier agrees is prohibited.

side_effects.description: Externally observable effects. Each must reference its outbox record and, where applicable, its reconciliation probe outcome (INV-EXT-1/2).

attribution.description: Delegated identity for external communication (SR-031, DR-025, RB-012). Required for any outbound message or call.

degradations.description: RB-022 / INV-SCENE-2 -- silent degradation is prohibited. Present even when empty.

class.description: Versioned taxonomy (REM-012 s5). Each class has a declared handling policy; an unclassified error is itself a defect.

user_visible_message.description: SR-004 requires the error type and retry time to be shown, not just logged.

claim.description: REM-010 s4.1. Grounding is tracked PER CLAIM, not per response -- a response that is 95% grounded with one fabricated specific reads as grounded under per-response tracking.

support_type.description: INV-EVID-1: 'model_prior' is not emittable as an assertion in research, memory_write, world_fact, or input_to_consequential_action.

support.description: INV-EVID-2: each ref resolves to a REPRODUCIBLE retrieved span. A similarity score is never sufficient grounding.

allOf.$comment: INV-EVID-2 -- a non-model_prior claim with no support is malformed.
INV-TASK-1 -- a succeeded result must carry a passing verification record.
